lex:
ψύχω
[in LXX for קוּר, שָׁטַח ;]
to breathe, blow; hence, to make cool. Pass., to grow cool: metaphorically, Mat.24:12.†

strongs.def: to breathe (voluntarily but gently, thus differing on the one hand from G4154 (πνέω), which denotes properly a forcible respiration; and on the other from the base of G109 (ἀήρ), which refers properly to an inanimate breeze), i.e. (by implication, of reduction of temperature by evaporation) to chill (figuratively)
